steps.name: Grani
steps.text: It's so dark in this corridor... And there's barely any space!

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: S-sorry... It's still just a tiny attic after all, but at least it's easy to stay hidden here!

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: The bounty hunters destroyed the mills, the warehouses, and even the electrical room. They probably won't bother looking in this tiny place.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Hope you're right... Ugh, looks like the two of us can just barely squeeze into this crevice?!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Carol, don't you think your face is a bit too close to mine?

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Sorry... Um, Officer?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Don't worry about the 'officer' stuff, just call me Grani.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Um, Grani, you said earlier that you found our village's request for aid...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Yes, and in that request, you mentioned that you actually do have information regarding some treasure?

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: The location of the treasure as well as the key required to open it are secretly passed from chieftain to chieftain, from one generation to the next.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: I can't tell you anything more specific though... Sorry, I'm not trying to hide anything from you.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Don't worry. We can talk about it after I've fully earned your trust.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Those bounty hunters have been threatening us ever since they found out about this.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: They destroyed our farmland, stole our winter rations, and have been harassing the villagers... If I didn't offer myself up, the village would've been done for.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: As long as they knew that I held the key to the treasure, they wouldn't hurt the villagers anymore.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: But you had to suffer like that...

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: ...Mm, I'm aware that it was just a short-term solution.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: I'm glad you made it.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Aw, Miss Carol...

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: We may have asked you to help us find the treasure in our message, but what we really wanted was to get rid of those pesky bounty hunters and restore peace to our village.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: For us, mentioning that treasure was the only solution we had.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Gold coins or whatever... those will be spent one day. But this land is the only home we have, and we plan to stay here forever.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Using the treasure to hire someone else to throw out the bounty hunters is another option.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: If there's enough funds in there, you could even hire a small army of mercenaries!

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Now that we have a plan, we need to find some way of slipping past these hooligans and leaving the village.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: You can see outside from this window— Ngh... it seems a bit high.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Miss Carol, can you try looking outside the window and seeing if the bounty hunters are still looking for us?

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: I... I can't reach it either. The window's too high up...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: I'll hold you up then...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Hup! Can you see better now?

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Okay, I can see——

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Eek?!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Miss Carol! Stop wriggling around so much!

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: B-but... What was that...

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Just now, someone flew right by the window...?
